title: Sample probability density
statement: For a small-bias Fourier input, its sample density is the uniform pushforward of the uniform distribution on the finite sample index set under its sample map. It is a probability density on the binary cube of dimension equal to the associated generator input's output dimension.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying bias input has output dimension $n>0$.
Twice the bias numerator is at most the bias denominator.
The Fourier bound is a natural number at least one.
The sample index set is nonempty.
